subject: Obtaining unstandardized factor scores in CFA

messages.author: cc93bfc7ba887e68
messages.subject: Obtaining unstandardized factor scores in CFA
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to extract factor scores from a CFA to use in further analysis. The model is a
longitudinal measurement invariance model with one factor and two measurement points. I'm using the empirical bayes modal since the individual items are ordinal (and ML yields some unplausible data, likely due to skewness of item distributions). 

 In further analysis I want to test for several latent mean changes between the measurement points in the context of a cross lagged panel model using the intercepts of the second measurement points. Hence the question -  is it possible to get unstandardized factor scores of the latents with lavPredict using EBM?

The model was estimated using DWLS and strong MI is enforced (thresholds + loadings constrained) - if that is of any help.

Thanks a lot!

Best
Alex

parts: If you have done invariance testing, why not test mean changes in the factor model? That would be the recommendation, instead of using factor scores

messages.author: cc93bfc7ba887e68
messages.subject: Re: Obtaining unstandardized factor scores in CFA
parts:
thanks for the reply! 

This was the original idea. The problem is that I also test for a mean change cross-sectionally within a different model that is formulated as a multigroup CFA (using theta parameterization, marker items for the identification of factor variances and means and the procedure proposed by Millsap & Tein (2004) for variances and intercepts of latent item-responses) in order to get a free estimate of the intercept of the latent variable in group 2. This model runs smoothly.

However, I want to include covariates of the latent variable (extending the MG-CFA into an MGMIMIC model) and this is where the model is unable to converge (simply by adding regressions of covariates to the latent to the model syntax).

Im using measeq.syntax from the semTools package for the model syntax.

In order to proceed I will either have to obtain unstandardized factor scores (original questions) or get the MGMIMIC model up and running. Any suggestions are greatly appreciated!

Thanks!

Best
Alex
